taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺銀無人機共同供應契約簽約 詠昇取得訓練機組品項
taiwan_aviation.summary: 世紀民生旗下詠昇電子取得臺灣銀行採購部無人機組共同供應契約中的「訓練用無人機組」品項，並於今天完成簽約。各機關預估採購需求為3,894臺，預估契約金額約新臺幣1.32億元。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: 詠昇電子 Signs 台灣銀行 Drone Supply Contract for Training Sets
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: 詠昇電子, a subsidiary of 世紀民生, secured the “training drone set” item under 台灣銀行採購部’s joint supply contract for drone sets and completed signing today. Estimated procurement demand from agencies is 3,894 units, and the estimated contract value is about NT$132 million.

international_aviation.headline: 美國南部邊境無人機限制生效 禁止未授權活動
international_aviation.summary: 美國運輸部（DOT）、Department of War（DoW）與國土安全部（DHS）宣佈，已在美國南部邊境實施無人機臨時飛航限制。限制自今日生效，禁止未經授權的無人機活動；適用範圍自地面至離地400英尺，並沿美國與墨西哥邊界向北延伸一海里。
international_aviation.headline_en: U.S. Activates Restrictions on Unauthorized Drones Along Southern Border
international_aviation.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), Department of War (DoW) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) announced a coordinated temporary flight restriction for drones along the southern U.S. border. The restriction is effective today. It prohibits unauthorized drone activity from the surface to 400 feet above ground level and extends one nautical mile north of the U.S.-Mexico border.

international_aviation.headline: FAA與NATCA達成空管人員2.8%加薪協議
international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）與National Air Traffic Controllers Association（NATCA）達成協議，為空中交通管制員加薪2.8%。FAA新聞稿指出，調薪於Oct. 18生效，並追溯至年初。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA and NATCA reach 2.8% pay deal for air traffic controllers
international_aviation.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the National Air Traffic Controllers Association (NATCA) have reached a deal to provide air traffic controllers with a 2.8% pay increase. The FAA said the increase takes effect Oct. 18 and is retroactive to the beginning of the year.

international_aviation.headline: J-Air訂購最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2更新機隊
international_aviation.summary: 日本航空旗下區域航空公司J-Air將增加最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2。訂單包括16架確定訂單及10架選擇權；報導指出，這批飛機將取代該公司的E170與E190機隊，交付預計自2029年開始。
international_aviation.headline_en: J-Air orders up to 26 Embraer E190-E2 aircraft for fleet renewal
international_aviation.summary_en: J-Air, the regional carrier of Japan Airlines, is adding up to 26 Embraer E190-E2 aircraft. The package comprises 16 firm orders and 10 options. The aircraft are intended to replace the carrier’s E170/E190 fleet, with deliveries expected from 2029, Aerospace Global News reported.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空要求部分飛往法蘭克福航班攜帶額外燃油
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空要求部分飛往法蘭克福的航班攜帶額外燃油，理由是對供應的疑慮。報導摘要並提到，這則消息出現在今年較早時期的航班削減之後；摘要稱，先前削減航班是由燃油價格危機所驅動。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa orders extra fuel on select Frankfurt-bound flights amid supply concerns
international_aviation.summary_en: Simple Flying reports that Lufthansa has ordered select flights bound for Frankfurt to carry extra fuel over concerns about supply. The source's summary says the news follows flight cuts earlier in the year and attributes those cuts to the fuel price crisis.

international_aviation.headline: Aviation Capital Group向空中巴士訂購75架A320neo系列客機
international_aviation.summary: Aviation Capital Group（ACG）向空中巴士訂購75架A320neo系列客機。AeroTime報導，這是ACG這家美國租賃公司的歷來最大筆飛機採購。ACG表示，這批飛機預定於2032年至2035年間交付。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus secures ACG order for 75 A320neo family aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus has secured an order from Aviation Capital Group (ACG) for 75 A320neo family aircraft. AeroTime described it as the US lessor’s largest aircraft purchase to date. ACG said the aircraft are scheduled to arrive between 2032 and 2035.

international_aviation.headline: 俄羅斯多座機場限制運作 航班仍有延誤
international_aviation.summary: Interfax報導，莫斯科的 Sheremetyevo Airport（SVO）、Domodedovo Airport（DME）、Vnukovo Airport及Zhukovsky Airport（ZIA）於2026年10月15日至16日受到運作限制，措施是為了「確保飛航安全」。Interfax另報導，聖彼得堡的 Pulkovo Airport（LED）在夜間暫停航班運作。俄羅斯媒體報導，總計有22座機場受到運作限制。
international_aviation.headline_en: Russian Airports Restrict Operations Amid Overnight Drone Activity
international_aviation.summary_en: Moscow’s Sheremetyevo Airport (SVO), Domodedovo Airport (DME), Vnukovo Airport and Zhukovsky Airport (ZIA) faced restrictions between October 15 and 16, 2026, to “ensure flight safety.” Interfax also reported that St Petersburg Pulkovo Airport (LED) suspended flight operations overnight. Russian media reported restricted operations at 22 airports in total.
